main_text.p: 10 Sacerdotes autē portantes arcā stabăt in medio Iordanis donec compleretur omnis sermo quem præceperat Iehoua ad Iofuam, vt diceret populo: prorsus vt præceperat Moses ipsi Iofue: festinauit autem populus transeundo.
11 Quum verò transeundi finem se cilTet vniuersus populus transiuit arca Iehouæ, & sacerdotes coră populo.
12 Transierunt quoque filii Ruben, & filii Gad, & dimidia tribus Menasse armati ante filios Israel: quemadmodum loquutus fuerat ad eos Moses.
13 Quadraginta milia armatorum transierunt coram Iehoua ad prælium ad campestria Iericho.
14 Eo die magnificauit Iehoua Iofuam in oculis totius Israelis: & timuerunt eum quemadmodum timuerant Mosen omnibus diebus vitæ eius.

page.notes: Catchword absent. Section numbers 10–14 are verse numbers in the text. The word "cilTet" is printed as "cisset" with a damaged s; read as "cesset" possibly. "transeundi" and "transeundo" as printed. Last line is cut off at the line end: "Lo-" is a hyphenated fragment.
